PartDesc_Fiat126p_Front Light Cover_Main: Timeless lamp covers. Tinted glass gives the car a mysterious character and elegance worthy of a higher class.
PartDesc_Rooster: It's light feels unsettling to you somehow.
PartDesc_Police_Loud_Speaker: Eyes wide open, mouth shut, ears - well, actually deaf because of how loud this thing is.
PartDesc_Speaker: Let the whole village know who blasts the best music from their car.
PartDesc_Keyboard: An essential - often also the only - music tool of a wedding band.
PartDesc_IronBoard: It's used for ironing clothes. No clue why anyone would want this to be mounted in a car.
PartDesc_TreeLights: "Mommy, mommy! The christmas tree is burning!"
PartDesc_Balloon_01: A colorful object made of rubber which can be filled with air. Random color.
PartDesc_Balloon_01_BUDOPOLEX: A balloon with an ad for a local building supplies company.

FluidDesc_Wine: "Sok z gumimalin" is very aromatic, east european Wine
FluidDesc_WindshieldWasher: This fluid is for windshield washers, washers are for cleaning the glass, and the glass is so you can see the road clearly while driving
FluidDesc_Water: Water, like any water, has many uses. Comes in big containers, perfect for turning into a still for homemade spirits
FluidDesc_Petrol: Highly flammable, dangerous, but pretty useful if you want your car to get from point A to point B
FluidDesc_Oil: Motor oil, suitable for both the engine and the gearbox.
FluidDesc_Coolant: Coolant fluid is useful - as the name suggests - for cooling. But if you really want to, you can always boil it
FluidDesc_BrakeFluid: Brake fluid, made for braking. And yes, it actually braking
FluidDesc_Beer: JEB beer. The taste is as simple as the name
FluidDesc_EmptyContainer: An empty container in which various liquids can be mixed. To mix liquids in external containers, an alchemy table is required.
FluidDesc_DishSoap: 10-in-1 liquid - for hair, body, toilet disinfection, and occasionally for washing dishes. It can also quite effectively replace windshield washer fluid.
ProductDesc_Vodka_1: Can you taste it? No? Don't worry - these dregs make you lose more than just your senses
FluidDesc_Moonshine: Country moonshine loosens tongues, ruins eyesight, and fixes tractors. Tastes like fire, smells like grandpa's revenge, and hits faster than the mailman before Christmas.
FluidDesc_Moonshine_ForestSpirit: Moonshine so strong even wild boars salute before the first sip. You don't go home after it - you return to nature.
FluidDesc_Moonshine_Methanol: It is produced during moonshine distillation when the proportions are incorrect
FluidDesc_BadProduct: Nobody even knows what it is.
FluidDesc_Yeast: The cheapest worker in the world - doesn't talk, doesn't sleep, just eats sugar and pees alcohol. Without them, there's no moonshine
FluidDesc_Potato: Solid base for a hearty meal... and a strong drink
FluidDesc_Sprite_Lemonidas: A nice citrusy soft drink from the west.
FluidDesc_CocaCola_KoloPopta: Incredible taste. You might as well lay an egg from that.
FluidDesc_MajorekMoonshine: An insanely strong alcohol, made in homemade conditions by Majorek and his brother-in-law.
FluidDesc_KitchenOil: Polish canola oil for various usecases. You can sear a pork chop on it and after you pour it into the engine, you can drive around the whole world with it.
PROLOGUE_JobDesc_Golf_Christopher: And here he is - the village maharaja in person. Satisfied with the job, he'll whisper a word to the right people and clients will swarm. Dissatisfied - you don't want to know.
PROLOGUE_JobDesc_SmallFiat_Angelica: Blonde as a blonde - she'll agree to a turn signal fluid change, fixing two gearboxes, or topping up the tires with premium air. And just like with the car, daddy's paying for everything anyway...
PROLOGUE_JobDesc_Polonez_Sebastian: Local village brawler needs a pimped-out ride. The car's sills are eaten by rust. Get the car to a usable state, he might even pay... if he's got anything on him.
JobDesc_SmallFiat_Pantofel: Wife told him to buy a Maluch, and now she's complaining that she doesn't like the color... She dreamed of green, but she'll probably change her mind again in a week. Help the poor guy or he'll get a rolling pin to the head.
JobDesc_Polonez_Simpleton: The client wanted to prove to his wife that he can hammer out the bodywork himself after hail. Well, he hammered it so badly that now it needs fixing after him. Sort out this paint and top up some fuel.
JobDesc_SmallFiat_Halina: I lightly scraped the curb with the wheel, and this junk just started knocking... And louder day by day! At first the radio still drowned out the noise, then I had to open the windows, but after a month I said: enough! So here I am. Will you take a look, sir?
JobDesc_Golf_FreshDriver: She recently bought a car, but now she's having nothing but problems. She complains about weak starting, and once it moves, it's loud, stalls uphill and heats up quickly. She added some other oil recommended by a colleague from work, but now she's not sure if it was a good idea.
JobDesc_Golf_FestivalInTrouble: This is the local festival organizer - he was driving to the municipal office to discuss the next date, but the car stalled on the way. He complains about the engine "choking" and asks to top up oil and fuel while at it.
JobDesc_SmallFiat_BlackGold: The client was talking about a new, better oil mixture he recently used, unfortunately his car didn't like it, so it needs to be completely changed. At the same time he also wants a battery replacement, because the car has starting problems.
JobDesc_Polonez_VillageAristocrat: He bought the latest Solonez model with company profits. After a few years of driving around his facilities, the car starts making squeaks from the front while driving. For a businessman this is unacceptable - he needs a reliable car. The client expects the squeak to be removed so he can drive without disturbances again.
JobDesc_Golf_RustedCar: The car always stood under the open sky. There's a garage, but you know - bicycle, jars, aunt's sofa bed... And now I have: rusty sills, rusty wheel arches, I don't even look underneath. The discs rusted so much that when I brake it sounds like a freight train to Katowice. Can it be saved?
JobDesc_Golf_Housewife: I won't beat around the bush: the car stinks terribly. As if something crawled in and died. I'm a mother, so I've become immune to extreme smells, but this is too much even for me...
JobDesc_SmallFiat_ElectricPension: My Heniek took care of this car more than of me. At first he only drove to church. Then he gave that up too, because it was a shame for the engine... But I have other plans for it - I'm going to drive this toy into the ground! Start it up and repaint it red so it will be faster!
JobDesc_SmallFiat_SpeedyStachu: The man came to the workshop because of brake problems. He claims the brake pedal is getting harder and harder, and the car doesn't stop as quickly as it should. He suspects the braking system is not working properly and asks for repair.
JobDesc_Janina: The client reported that her car started having problems maintaining normal engine temperature - the temperature gauge often shows too high a value. Additionally she asks for replacement of locks in both doors and replacement of the air system.
JobDesc_SmallFiat_GhostsInTheEngine: Dear sir - something is knocking under the hood. I already have trauma, because last time it was knocking like that, a cat got wrapped around the timing shaft... I start it and think it's the belt or something... But it's "Lucky". Well... the name is not very fitting, I must say... So, will you take a look?
JobDesc_Golf_NightRider: The client often returns home in the evenings, so she could use working lights so she doesn't hit some tree. Besides bulb replacement she also asks for new tires and car wash.
JobDesc_SmallFiat_VillageDiplomat: Hello! The company car broke down, so I dragged the old Maluch out of the garage. It stood for a while, got a bit rusty - start it up and make it look decent. After all, public money can't go to waste! I mean... private of course.
JobDesc_Polonez_FoggyBlinkers: Grzesiek reports to the mechanic with the problem of fogged indicator lenses. They need to be replaced with new ones. Additionally he asks to top up brake fluid.
JobDesc_Polonez_CarburetorInFog: Mrs. Stasia complains about high fuel consumption and problems with starting the engine. She also claims the engine is not running evenly. She asks for repair, as well as replacement of fog light lenses and rust removal.
JobDesc_SmallFiat_ExhaustAndShine: Mister mechanic - 3 things: First of all: Something is shooting from the exhaust. Second primo: The bulb doesn't light. And most important: Paint it blue. It has to be elegant so people look and think: "Oh, a serious owner". Not: "Oh, that guy with the shooting muffler again"...
JobDesc_SmallFiat_OneWayDriving: Mr. Janusz, this junk steers itself to the left... On a straight road, as soon as I let go of the wheel, I immediately greet the ditch... And these brakes... I press the pedal and have a moment to think about my life... Only after a while they start to grab. Can something be done about it?
JobDesc_SmallFiat_FastAndCheap: The local Janusz Business admitted that he recently used a cheaper oil mixture and watered-down fuel - he quickly realized it wasn't the best idea. Now the oil, fuel and filters need to be changed. At the same time he also wants to get rid of the rust.
JobDesc_UrsusC355_JanekLesny: Janek, who spends more time in the forest than at home, dragged in a Knursus because something is knocking the pistons in it. He claims that due to forest moisture the V-belt is slipping, and the fuel filter is barely breathing. Fix it for him, because otherwise he'll be carrying wood on his back.
JobDesc_UrsusC355_TadekZniwiarz: Tadek has a problem with his tractor, supposedly "smoking like a dragon at a wedding". He blames bad fuel from his brother-in-law, and the brother-in-law blames the bad tractor driver. Doesn't matter who's right - fix what needs fixing, otherwise he'll have to plow the field with a shovel.
JobDesc_UrsusC355_ZochaOdKur: Zocha brought the Knursus because it squeaks worse than a hen laying an egg. She says it's probably the brakes or something in the alternator system, but who knows - maybe there's just a laying hen under the hood...
JobDesc_UrsusC355_WacekBimbrownik: Rick, the village moonshine master, rolled in the Knursus because "the engine is wheezing like after his special". Fix the tractor, he might even treat you to that magical brew.
JobDesc_UrsusC355_Harvest: Harvest is just around the corner, and when the client pulled the Knursus out of the shed he saw that there was no air in the tires, and the rims are completely rusted. If you don't fix them, this year's harvest will be poor.
JobDesc_UrsusC355_GienekRybak: The fisherman drives to the pond with the Knursus, complains that he has a problem - "the tractor stalls like a fish out of water". He thinks it's from the wetlands, but you see that the ignition system is flooded. Fix it for him before he starts rowing the tractor and telling everyone you're a hack.
JobDesc_UrsusC355_GieniaWeselna: Gienia has a head for business - when someone in the village organizes a wedding, she hauls the band on the Knursus trailer. Unfortunately, the business is threatened because the tractor is starting to fall apart. Sort it out, she might even get you an invitation to the next wedding.
JobDesc_UrsusC355_FranekAnonimowy: Franek has a problem - while working in the field instead of going straight he plows in a slalom. But what can you expect - the lights don't shine, and he plows at night. But as if that wasn't enough, he hides a bottle of booze under his jacket, so it's pretty hard to drive straight in such conditions.
JobDesc_UrsusC355_Marianek: The client and his brother-in-law changed the spark plugs after the Knursus had starting problems, but it didn't help. Take a look at what's broken and fix it - he might pay.
Q10_JobDesc_Golf_Kamil: A broke customer? Luckily, he came to the right place. In this job, a bit of sloppy work is actually welcome - Kamil wants the car fixed, not to go bankrupt.
JobDesc_Zuk_Anka: Before she goes shopping, Anka decided the car won't look like last year. Again daddy will pay for the new color and everything needed so Żul looks like new.
JobDesc_Zuk_HotDays: The car is heating up because all the coolant has evaporated. Fill it up and sort it out so the problem doesn't come back in a few days.
JobDesc_Zuk_InsideJob: The matter is simple - the benches in the trunk need replacing, and the front seats aren't shining with novelty either. Everything is worn out and it's time for replacement. Do it quickly, because the client doesn't want to look at these faded boards.
JobDesc_ZukPickup_LightlyUsed: This time on the driveway - a rusty Żul. The client wants to get rid of it, but before he does, he needs a proper refresh, because who will buy such junk? Repaint it properly so it can still serve someone else. Let it look like new, not like a wreck.
JobDesc_Zuk_IgnitionProblems: The Żul won't start, something is wrong with the ignition. Maybe the spark plugs or the whole ignition system. The client is afraid it's the end, but maybe a small adjustment will be enough for the car to drive like new again.
JobDesc_ZukPickup_Needle: This grandma's Żul is a real old man. It hasn't been in the workshop for a long time so no wonder things are creaking. Don't expect the client to figure out herself what's happening with the braking system. Fix everything before she causes an accident.
JobDesc_ZukPickup_Jarek: Jarek has a Żul he only drives around the village, but he demands from this car like from a luxury one. Now he's complaining that something is wrong with the electrics again. Do what needs to be done so he can proudly drive the village roads again.
JobDesc_ZukPickup_PluggedPipes: Żul on Mr. Wiktor's farm is an important work tool. The problem is that the engine is getting harder and harder to start, and on top of that the muffler is starting to shoot. Usually it's the fault of a clogged air system. A filter replacement is necessary. While at it, wash it and fill the tank.
JobDesc_Zuk_Rafal: Raphael often drove his Żul, but lately he went too wild and drove it into a ditch. Luckily for him the only thing that happened was some dented bodywork. While at it change his tires so he doesn't drive into another ditch.
JobDesc_Nysa_MoreThanAScratch: The client was reversing and hit the fence with the Rysa. Generally it will be better to go through the whole car and nicely fill it. The client is also bored with the current color, repaint it to another.
JobDesc_Nysa_BigGuy: A guy built like a three-door wardrobe walked into the workshop, all in sand and with a tan like from a grill. He says his Rysa started coughing after the last mud bath. He suspects the filter, but it could just as well be "something with the engine, sir".
JobDesc_Nysa_GrandpasCar: Grandpa Kazik last changed tires 5 years ago. High time for replacement, because on frost the car slides on the road like a pig on ice.
JobDesc_Nysa_BestWeddingEver: Rychu from the neighboring village is getting married. He wanted to rent a limousine, but his brother-in-law came up with the idea that if you pimps up the Rysa well, it will do the job too. It has to be white and while at it all fluids can be topped up.
JobDesc_Nysa_ThirstyRysa: The mayor's wife dropped by because she heard that her Rysa burns more fuel than Zenek's tractor. She suspects it's because of "those new gasolines they give now", but the mayor told her to check the carburetor because supposedly something got out of adjustment.
JobDesc_Nysa_RysaJockey: The village head organized a competition - Rysa vs horse. The horse won... Ferdek got pissed, and wants to fix her up. She has to come out as a sports beast! Time doesn't matter, but if we lose to the horse again, it's embarrassment for the whole village.
JobDesc_Nysa_Proboszcz: The parish priest came in a Rysa he received as a gift of heart from the faithful. He claims something knocks when driving over cobblestones, and when braking it "squeaks somehow devilishly". He doesn't tinker himself because holy hands, and in return for the repair he'll mention you in the next sermon.
JobDesc_Nysa_WetCar: After the last wash the Rysa started jerking strangely, as if something got air-locked. She suspects water might have gotten into the fuel system, causing problems with starting and engine operation. Check if anything got wet and replace what needs replacing.
JobName_Nysa_MoreThanAScratch: A bit more than a Rysa
JobName_Nysa_ThirstyRysa: Village Head's wife has a Rysa
Q14_JobDesc_BigFiat_Cousin: Cousin wanted a car in true American style. You bought him a car, and the seller dropped it off. Time to turn it into an American wet dream...
S_Quest_JobDesc_WoodBlackMarket: Next deal of a lifetime: fix up Mietek's wreck so together with him open a company that will squeeze Gienek out of the illegal wood poaching market!
S_Quest_JobDesc_WoodBlackMarket_Intro: Mietek is calling you, ask him what's up.
S_Quest_JobDesc_WoodBlackMarket_WaitForC:
Wait until Mietek brings his car
Free up space in the garage and on the driveway
S_Quest_JobDesc_WoodBlackMarket_SellWood: Sell Mietek a full crate of wood
S_Quest_JobDesc_WoodBlackMarket_TabDesc: Mietek has some plan to sell wood at better prices for a favor
Q19_JobDesc_Polonez_Bolted: Fix a car lock with a barn bolt? Such things only happen in movies - and in Polish villages. Well, the client needs a sloppy job so get to work.
S_Quest_JobDesc_Mowing_TakeCarJob: Need to fix Lucas' tractor, which he bought from Dobek in order to give a goat to Renia. Fuck, what transactions...
S_Quest_JobDesc_DriverHunt: He drove into the old lady's house with a Solonez. Now it needs to be fixed, many parts are missing - he installed whatever he could to push the car to the mechanic. The Solonez also needs to be cleaned, filled and painted.
Q22_JobDesc_Golf_SweetRevenge: Turkish telenovela... The son stole the mayor's car, but crashed it into a tree. He told his father that someone stole the car. The mayor announced a search, and now the car is here, and we'll use it against Jarzyna...
JobName_SmallFiat_PearTree: Miecio and that unfortunate pear tree!
JobDesc_SmallFiat_PearTree: Sir, my Mietek went to the shop in the morning with our clunker and came back in such a state. I mean the Maluch - Mietek in even worse... No one knows what he hit... Fix it quickly sir, because shame on the whole village...
JobName_SmallFiat_BoxOfMatches: Box of Matches and Hot Head
JobDesc_SmallFiat_BoxOfMatches: Sir, yesterday I was driving to my aunt and suddenly the car started making a tremendous noise! Something banged when I was starting! Now it barely breathes and I'm afraid something will happen again! And those doors of his, I'm already ashamed to open them - all rusty and faded!
JobDesc_Polonez_DancingPolonez: Sir, yesterday evening I was coming back from the party and suddenly I hear "bang!" under the hood! I barely made it home, and in the morning the car wouldn't start. Take a look sir at what got fucked up there...
JobDesc_Polonez_DatingInPolonez: My son went on a date and what? Instead of with the girl, he came back with a smashed Solonez! All crumpled, and so dirty I don't know! Repaint it sir in some color so the brat loses the taste for joyrides.
JobDesc_Zuk_StrangeManeuvers: Sir! I was driving with a delivery to the neighboring village, the road, as roads are, full of holes, but suddenly I feel - something is roaring from the back, jerking! I look in the mirror, and there... Tires went to shit... It sways from side to side! And the engine is somehow weakening, and something is splashing under the hood!
JobDesc_BigFiat_SundayTrip: Sir, with this Fiax of mine I'm going to go gray! I wanted to take the family on a trip, and it didn't even budge! I turn the key, it coughs and sputters! Neighbor said something with the ignition. Once it catches, it jerks! Save it sir!
JobDesc_Golf_GermanGift: Sir, with this Gulv I have nothing but trouble! I got it from my brother-in-law from Germany, supposedly a needle, and here what? Since yesterday nothing, zero! While it was standing, it seems to me that something under the hood started wheezing, as if it was going to fall apart! I'm afraid to move it, or it will completely break down!
JobDesc_Nysa_DarknessAtTheBack: Sir! I was driving the Rysa with milk, and suddenly a militiaman stopped me! 'Nothing is shining from the back for you!' - he says. And I didn't know anything! How am I supposed to deliver the milk safely now?!
JobDesc_SmallFiat_FilterThis: Something was wheezing from the back, usually a kick was enough and that was it, now it didn't help. I got in, put reverse and rammed into a tree to make it stop, but my foot slipped and I think I wrecked it even more.
JobDesc_SmallFiat_Fugitive: Quick action - police are chasing me because I wrote "2137" on the fence. You have to repaint my car quickly and refuel! Get moving sir!
JobDesc_SmallFiat_SomethingFellOff: Mr. mechanic! I was driving the Maluch to my friend's, and suddenly something fell off it and the car roars like crazy! Save me sir, because I won't make it to the neighbor's...
JobDesc_SmallFiat_NoSpark: With this Maluch of mine it's probably only for scrap! I wanted to drive to the car wash, and it didn't even catch! I turn, turn, and nothing! Zero spark! Neighbor mentioned something about some belt and coil, but I don't know anything about it.
JobDesc_SmallFiat_LoudBreathing: For a few days the car has been roaring terribly, as if some animal was choking under the hood. The engine is whistling strangely and has no power! I'm afraid to drive, or it will completely fall apart in the middle of the road!
JobDesc_Polonez_CoughingCar: For a few days the car has been choking badly, especially in the morning when starting. It smokes mercilessly at the same time, as if something was burning under the hood! And this lack of power, sir, I barely drive uphill! If it goes on like this, they'll send me to scrap!
JobDesc_Polonez_CrookedTravels: As soon as I move from the spot, it starts shaking like jelly! The whole shed jumps up, and the steering wheel flies in all directions! I feel like every wheel wants to go in a different direction!
JobDesc_Polonez_GingerCar: My Solonez looks like after a visit to the mine, rusty spots everywhere! On top of that yesterday morning it didn't even budge, silence! As if the power was cut! Total disaster! Help sir, because it's rusting before my eyes!
JobDesc_Nysa_Rattling: Dear sir, I dented the bumper on a curb, and on top of that the braking distance lengthened so much that I had to brake through the whole village before stopping at yours! And this Rysa... looks like a herd of cows attacked it, so dirty! Please, bring it to order.
JobDesc_Nysa_ComingToStonestock: We're going to the Stonestock festival and we want to repaint the car! While at it maybe you can hammer it out somehow?
JobDesc_Nysa_NoPower: The engine is coughing, sputtering, as if the car is falling apart! On top of that it happens to smoke, as if something inside is burning, and it has as much power as nothing!
JobDesc_Nysa_UnfortunateLights: What can I tell you sir? I'm an idiot! I had to push-start it today to even get here, because I left the lights on at night. On top of that the temperature is jumping hard in it, can something be done about it?
JobDesc_Nysa_QuickThinking: I turn the key and nothing - the car won't start. I pushed it here, but what do I do now? I have to deliver the goods! Please do something quickly sir, or I'll lose customers!
JobDesc_Nysa_EnginePuzzles: Take a look into the engine. It seems to me that something is not right because the car behaves very strangely and makes a strange sound when starting.
JobDesc_SmallFiat_RaceToTheShop: Today I was taking my mother-in-law to the clinic, and that beast weighs about 100 kilos... On the first hole the springs refused obedience. On the second I refused a Hail Mary... It worked - I made it, but barely. Throw an eye on the scale of damage? I'm afraid...
JobDesc_SmallFiat_GardenExpress: On the weekend I took the Maluch to the allotment - you know, rakes, box of cucumbers, husband, dog and father-in-law added with some junk. When I drove into that holey forest track, something started wheezing from the back and the car became wobbly, as if the rear was dancing separately. Now at every turn I have the impression that my own axle will overtake me soon.
JobDesc_SmallFiat_RustyOnVacation: I went to the lake because the kids wanted to "experience adventure". The road was like after a bomb - potholes, holes, some concrete curbs. Now the steering wheel moves like a shopping cart, you have to fight with it, and at a bigger hole I have the impression that the whole load wants to escape to the side. Something in the back also started creaking, as if carrying an old sofa bed.
JobDesc_SmallFiat_ShakeDeluxer: I was driving to the village for potatoes and suddenly at higher speed the whole car started shaking like a centrifuge. Something underneath was banging rhythmically, as if someone was hammering from below. I stopped, looked - supposedly everything in place, but when I move, I have the impression that my ass will fall off soon.
JobDesc_Golf_LifelessGulv: I barely made it with the Gulv - first something started squeaking under the hood, then some light came on, and at the end everything dimmed. The last kilometers I drove without lights, hoping to reach the workshop before the battery died completely.
JobDesc_Golf_Collision: What can I say - the neighbor was reversing with a Syrenka and didn't notice my Gulv. Supposedly "the sun blinded him". The sheet metal on the doors looks like after being redrawn on concrete. I sorted what I could, but it would be good to straighten and cover it properly.
JobName_BigFiat_HotLikeaSteelMill: Hot as in a steel mill
JobName_BigFiat_OneSettotheBitterEnd: To the end on one set
JobDesc_BigFiat_RunningonThreeWheels: I was driving to the allotment and hit a hole. Something cracked in the front and now the car drives like a broken shopping cart. At higher speeds you can feel the whole front dancing, and on turns I have to fight with the steering wheel not to fly into the ditch.
JobDesc_BigFiat_BouncingonaSpring: Mr. master, I drove here straight from the GS, because when I fell into a hole by the dairy, the car started jumping like a boat on the Baltic. Now every bump is felt in the spine, and from the front something knocks and sways as if the sofa was on a trampoline. Wife refused further rides until "this couch stops flipping".
JobDesc_BigFiat_LikeaSteamEngine: The car wheezes as if someone poured a jar of nails under the hood. On top of that when I rev it, it smokes like a steam locomotive. Neighbor complains that the car is terribly loud and wakes him up every morning. While at it wash it, because it looks like it came back from the Dakar rally.
JobDesc_BigFiat_FlyingFrontEnd: For a few days the front of the car lives its own life - I go right, it goes left. I go left - it goes right... The whole suspension is rattling, and the wheels look like they want to go their separate ways.
JobDesc_BigFiat_DrivingBlind: For some time no one wants to give me right of way, and recently a bus almost rammed me - it turned out that neither the left indicator nor the front lights work. When dusk falls, I drive like a ghost: no one sees me, no one knows where I'm turning. Neighbor says I look like a saboteur from occupation times.
JobDesc_BigFiat_SecretBraking: A friend driving behind says that when I brake, it looks like I'm playing Russian roulette - no light, zero warning. During the day it still somehow works, but in the evening every now and then someone sits on my bumper because they think I'm not braking. The electrician in the store said that "it's probably old school driving by feel", but something tells me that's not how it was supposed to work.
JobDesc_BigFiat_EngineDoingItsOwnThing: The engine first started running unevenly, then sometimes had power, sometimes not, and finally stalled at the lights and didn't get up again. When starting it only cranks and gasps, as if wondering if it even wants to anymore. With the neighbor we tinkered a bit under the hood, but when we saw what the gears look like, we decided it's better not to touch it without holy water.
JobDesc_BigFiat_GuessingandNoWarning: For some time the steering wheel has such play that to turn left I first have to make a circle to the right. On top of that the brake lights disappeared - no one behind me knows when I'm braking, and one guy at the lights said I drive like a fortune teller. In the current state I feel like I'm driving a sofa with a flashlight taped on.
JobDesc_BigFiat_MoodyEngine: The car starts once in ten tries, and when it does move, it runs as if on three cylinders and jerks with every gas. Lately while driving something creaked, the engine coughed and died like a candle in a draft. Acquaintance says it's probably the belt got offended, and the spark plugs probably still remember Gierek.
JobDesc_BigFiat_HotLikeaSteelMill: The engine heats up so much that you could fry eggs on it - the temperature needle is about to go off the scale. The fan burps once in a blue moon, and oil leaks from under the engine like from a leaking pan. At lights I have to turn off the car so it doesn't boil, and under the block I leave a bigger stain than the neighbor under the Wartburg.
JobDesc_BigFiat_StarvingEngine: The car chokes at every start, as if someone tightened the fuel tap. Once it catches revs, it drives, but a moment of stop is enough and it dies again. Neighbor mechanic told me it might be the filter, or some pump? But he's such a specialist that I'd rather give it to you sir.
JobDesc_BigFiat_DeadandDented: The car won't start, won't light, won't beep - like a corpse. Neighbor lent cables, but even after connecting it barely cranked and died at the first gas. And as if that wasn't enough, wife while reversing hit a metal post - fender and door now look like someone straightened them with a fist. Need to save it somehow, because shame to stand under the block.
JobDesc_BigFiat_BrakingwithaPrayer: At every braking something squeaks, rubs and jerks, as if the whole front is calling for mercy. The brake pedal has such play that I have to brake this car like a coal train. Sort out the topic, because next time I'll drive into someone's ass and there will be tragedy...
JobDesc_BigFiat_ReversingBlind: Under the block someone put a dumpster where it never was, and... the bumper is no longer a bumper, just a piece of deformed sheet metal. Need to straighten and fill it, and preferably cheaply...
JobDesc_BigFiat_LosingtoRust: The paint gave up long ago, because from orange it turned into rotten brown, and rust comes out everywhere - on doors, wheel arches, even on the roof as if the rain was acid. When I drive by, kids under the block shout that the Flintstones are coming. Need to sand it, sort it and paint it before the car falls apart by itself at the lights.
JobDesc_BigFiat_BarelyBreathingBarelyCha: The car more and more often stalls at idle, and the battery has died twice already, as if it wasn't charging at all. On top of that the engine chokes and gasps when accelerating, as if it lacks air. Acquaintance says the filter looks like from a furnace, and the alternator is probably just hitchhiking.
JobDesc_BigFiat_OneSettotheBitterEnd: A man says all his life: "it will last another season". And I got what I deserved. Rain fell and I got stuck up to the axles. In the end wife got out and started pushing. In new shoes... Hence our joint decision: we change the tires. To new ones. Oh Jesus, but this will be expensive...
JobDesc_BigFiat_FloatsLikeaCanoe: For a few days the front of the car flies from side to side at every turn, as if the suspension was made of jelly. When braking you can feel something shifting, and the steering wheel lives its own life. On holes it knocks, creaks and it's scary to accelerate, because I have the impression that the wheels will soon overtake the body.
JobDesc_Polonez_RoarAndRust: Lately when I started the Solonez, the neighbor from the third floor asked if I'm starting in a truck rally. On top of that the rust started eating the paint, so this car needs proper attention.
JobDesc_Polonez_SomethingStinksUpFront: While driving you can smell a strange odor from under the hood, and when accelerating the car starts to shake, as if it doesn't know where to go. On turns something rattles and starts pulling to one side. Acquaintance says it's probably some "filter", but I don't know.
JobDesc_Polonez_BouncingLikeABeachBall: Every hole is a drama - the car bounces, creaks and you can even feel in the spine that something in the front isn't working. When I get out, the whole side of the car still sways for a while. Something clearly stopped holding vertical.
JobDesc_Polonez_DirtyAndChoking: The car barely pulls, chokes when starting, and smoke comes from the pipe like from a bonfire. On top of that everything is covered with dust, mud and something that probably once was food. Need to wash it, ventilate and unclog, because it got clogged like a chimney after winter.
JobDesc_Polonez_WinterLove: Mom wanted to help me and in the morning before work she cleared the snow from Solonez... with a coal shovel. The roof now looks like someone tried to plow it. On top of that the engine chokes at every start, and when I fill the tank full, it burns like a tank on maneuvers.
JobDesc_Polonez_WhatDoYouMean: I came for inspection, and the diagnostician looked and only asked if I have a tow truck. Rust ate the sills and wheel arches, and the brakes are only brakes in name. I'm surprised, because even after old acquaintance with a bottle they didn't want to stamp it.
JobDesc_Polonez_MeetingwithaLamp: I was coming back in the evening and on the turn something pulled me - as a result I personally met the street lamp by the store. The right light went, bumper damaged and doors redrawn.
JobDesc_Polonez_CrookedSteering: For a few days when turning something creaks and I feel like the wheel wants to go its own way. On straight the car floats lightly, and at higher speed you have to hold the steering wheel tightly. And while at it - echo in the tank, so let's top it up with some special.
JobDesc_Cintek_SkidontheWayforBread: I was coming back in the morning from the bakery, and on the turn the car went into a slip and I hit the curb with the wheel. With every meter I have the impression that something will soon break off. Sort out what needs to be, and I'm going for a drink, because I'm shaking all over with nerves.
JobDesc_Cintek_WeddingDriftTuning: Cousin was coming back from the wedding in my car and decided he would do "spectacular entrances" under the hall. Now from the front the light is hanging, the bumper is hanging on one screw, and the hood has a new wave. When I look at it, I have the impression that the car was in the Dakar rally.
JobDesc_Cintek_GreenStainUndertheCar: A big green stain appeared on my driveway, and the engine temperature is jumping like crazy. The fan works when it wants, and from under the hood it stinks as if a rat died there. Let's fix this junk before the engine boils completely.
JobDesc_Cintek_UnwillingtoStart: For a week I'm starting the car like a lottery - once on the first try, once after five minutes of cranking. When it does start, it shakes like a washing machine in spin and stalls at intersections. I have the impression that the engine is fighting with itself.
JobDesc_Cintek_TheTrailerWon: I was driving around the city, and from the back they were honking, flashing and shouting. At home I checked and when braking nothing lights from the back. No wonder drivers were afraid to drive behind me.
JobDesc_Cintek_SmokeLikeTheHarvestFestiv: Maybe it's embarrassing to admit, but what can I say... There was a harvest festival, I drank a bit too much and got behind the wheel. And what? And I rear-ended a trailer on the allotment. Spare me the shame and fix this car...
JobDesc_Cintek_LouderThanATractor: When starting, such smoke comes from the pipe that people think I have a car with a steam boiler. On top of that the engine chokes when adding gas and sometimes completely stalls. I won't even mention that it's louder than a Knursus...
JobDesc_Cintek_SkidOnTheRoundabout: The car started howling at every addition of gas, and inside everything is shaking. At a stop it still passes, but on the road you can't talk. People look back at me as if I had a jet under the hood.
JobDesc_Cintek_UnclesRustbucket: I got the car from uncle - rust ate the sills, and the brakes almost don't work. When I start, everything shakes as if it was going to fall apart. I feel it's a miracle that it's still rolling.
JobName_Cintek_SkidontheWayforBread: Slip on the way for bread
JobDesc_Cintek_SummerHeatBreakdown: On the way to auntie's the temperature in the car shot up, until it started knocking under the hood. The car barely made it to the roadside and wouldn't start. I had to call the neighbor with the tractor.
JobDesc_UncleRustbucket: I got the car from uncle - rust ate the sills, and the brakes almost don't work. When I start, everything shakes as if it was going to fall apart. I feel it's a miracle that it's still rolling.
JobDesc_Nysa_RetiredFireNysa: I got an old Nyska from the fire brigade and wanted to drive it to fish. Unfortunately, on the first night it turned out that the lights hardly shine at all, and the rear stops don't work at all.
JobDesc_Nysa_DiscoTurnSignals: At every turn the flashers blink as they want - once they shine constantly, once not at all. On top of that the alternator whistles as if it was about to explode. Instead of carrying people, the Rysa makes a disco on wheels.
JobDesc_Nysa_HeavyontheRoad: Stalls at every addition of gas. Acquaintance says the fuel doesn't reach properly and the whole system chokes. On the parking lot everyone is already laughing that it's more of a kitchen than a car.
JobDesc_CoolingonVacation: On the way to the city the engine temperature jumped a lot, and steam flew from the hood like from a locomotive. It turned out that the radiator fan doesn't spin at all. Can something be done about it?
JobDesc_Nysa_OldPanels: The right bumper almost fell off, and the left one is also held by wire. On top of that the rear is covered in who knows what. Probably time to refresh this grandpa.
JobName_Nysa_HeavyontheRoad: Hard on the road, light in the stomach
JobDesc_Nysa_RattlingOrchestra: While driving something rattles and creaks from the front as if I was carrying a whole drum kit with me. It turned out that the suspension is barely breathing and holds on good word. Neighbor says you can hear me before you see me.
JobDesc_Nysa_CarburetorLikeaFireworks: The engine sputters, coughs and spits as if it decides itself when it wants to drive. The distributor sparks like New Year's Eve. Instead of driving I have a fireworks show.
JobDesc_Nysa_FuelinaLottery: Sometimes it drives normally, sometimes suddenly stalls as if offended. On the way to the store I had to start three times because the fuel system stops delivering gasoline. This is not a car, this is roulette.
JobDesc_Nysa_OnReserve: The tank dried up and the car looks like it drove through a potato field. You can't see the windows, mud up to the door handles - the car looks at least as if I was carrying cattle in it. No point talking...
JobDesc_Nysa_FrontAfteraBattle: At the intersection I bumped into a trailer and the whole front went to pieces. Bumper bent, lights smashed to bits, and the hood looks like an accordion. Passengers claim the Rysa looks like after a rally.
JobName_Nysa_FuelinaLottery: The fuel is not in the mood
JobDesc_UrsusC355_SawingonThePlot: My tractor drives me crazy at every attempt to start. The starter almost comes out of itself, and neighbors over the fence are betting whether it will succeed this time. Sort it out, because shame on the whole commune...
JobDesc_UrsusC355_GreenSmoke: Such smoke comes from the exhaust pipe that everyone asks if they elected a new pope. Someone must have added something to my fuel...
JobDesc_UrsusC355_TractorConcert: The engine plays like an orchestra - something knocks, something squeaks. A little longer and people will be buying tickets for the concert of this wreck.
JobDesc_UrsusC355_OuthouseOnWheels: The seat is so destroyed that every hole is torture for my spine - and on top of that the rear mud flaps fall off at the slightest nudge. Nothing, just shit in the middle...
JobDesc_UrsusC355_DeadAtTheStart: I turn the key and nothing - silence like in a cemetery. Then it catches, but only once in ten tries. As if offended.
JobDesc_UrsusC355_MuddyUrsus: The tractor after recent field work looks like it took part in a swamp rally. On top of that the front got hit by a stone that flew out from under the neighbor's rotary mower. Anyway what am I talking... with this junk everything is already falling apart. Help!
JobDesc_UrsusC355_IndigestibleUrsus: Instead of driving, the tractor chokes and sputters - fuel probably doesn't enter it as it should. Neighbor says it looks like it has heartburn. If it goes on like this, I'll have to give it mint instead of diesel.
JobDesc_UrsusC355_BlindAndToothless: Headlights failed, and the front looks like after a fight in the fire station - grille bent and nothing holds together. When night falls, driving it is like driving with a blindfold.
JobDesc_UrsusC355_DancingtoitsownBeat: The timing lives its own life - sometimes it runs evenly, sometimes like a drunk musician - here faster, there slower. It's only a matter of time until the pistons get fucked. While at it I have to change the triangle because the police chased me lately...
JobDesc_UrsusC355_UrsusSauna: After an hour of work in the field I feel like I'm sitting in a sauna - temperature jumps, fan doesn't cool, and the smell of burning like in a steel mill. And that's strange, because this tractor doesn't even have a cabin! If it goes on like this I'll get cooked here like an egg, do something about it...
JobDesc_Zuk_TotheField: After the whole season of carrying potatoes on the bed something started banging from the back when braking, and the car jumps like a kangaroo. They said the car is indestructible, but this one is already begging for rest.
JobDesc_Zuk_ISeeDarkness: Yesterday evening I was coming back from the market and everyone was flashing lights at me, and I myself could barely see anything in front of the hood. It turned out that both headlights failed - so I'm counting on you Mr. mechanic!
JobDesc_Zuk_StallingAtTheCrossroads: At every intersection when I stand the engine rebels and stalls. I have the impression that the car coughs more than many a smoker.
JobDesc_Zuk_OnOneLeg: At a sharp right turn the whole front sits down and rubs against the asphalt as if it wanted to take the wheel off itself. You can't drive this...
JobDesc_Zuk_SeatFromAnotherEra: The driver's seat is already so farted out that it resembles a wooden stool more than a seat. Sort it out and while at it do some inspection, because this and that probably needs repair in this car.
JobDesc_Nysa_PotatoSupplier: All spring I was carrying sacks of potatoes on the bed and now the seats are crushed and hard on the ass. On top of that mud and sand from the field stick so hard that I can't wash it off with a brush.
JobDesc_Nysa_DoorOnAString: The kids were playing on the truckbed and the whole backrests need replacing, and the rear doors I now close with baler twine. When I drive, I have the impression that the whole bed will soon fall apart like a wall unit.
JobDesc_ZukPickup_TarpLikeaSieve: After the last hail the tarpaulin looks like someone was practicing pitchfork throws on it - water pours straight onto the goods, and the frames hold only on honor and a piece of wire.
JobDesc_ZukPickup_FairgroundChairs: The front seats are so worn that the springs dig into the ass. On top of that the tarpaulin cracked and rain pours onto the bed. Supposedly cool - free pool, but still needs to be fixed.
Q9_JobDesc_BigFiat_RoadsideBusiness: As usual, the reliable Maluch got fucked... Help a woman in need and sort out what needs sorting in it.
JobDesc_Bodyguards: After Krzysio's painful visit to your yard, his muscular friends decided to take you on the last ride to the forest. Unfortunately, the car (which by the way you fixed some time ago) broke down, and those nice gentlemen offered you penance in the form of its repair, use this chance well...
SQ_JobDesc_Golf_ReallyFlyHood: Damian's brother-in-law told him what to pour into the car to make it run better. Well, it went so well, that the hood flew off, and now someone has to go look for it in the woods. The car won’t make it to the garage, so it’s time for some fieldwork.
SQ_JobDesc_Dropthebase: An aspiring DJ wants to create the ultimate party vehicle - as ridiculous as that may sound. The worst part is that you agreed to help him with it, so now you’re the one who has to do all the work.
SQ_JobDesc_LifeFindsAWay: You need to clean up and decorate Henry's old car so it's in the best possible shape for his daughter's last-minute wedding.
Letter_Cousin:
Yo cousin! It's me, Ejdrien - Aunt Elisabeth pride and joy.

I'm writing for you from America! I was supposed to come here just for a two-month dishwashing gig, but deep in my heart I already know - it's time for a passport upgrade.

Can't remember much from Poland these days, but when I do come back, I'll need some wheels - my old car got liberated (read: stolen).

You gotta hook me up with a ride. I sent some cash in the package - find something cheap and fix it up a bit.

Oh, and the most important thing - it better be AMERICAN. I refuse to cruise around like some kind of peasant.

P.S. As a token of my appreciation, I tossed in a console. Broaden your horizons a little. Enjoy!

God Bless America.
Ejdrien
Letter_Grandpa:
My treasure I hide so no stranger may steal,
Though the church is far off, its gaze I still feel.

From the scrapyard, take the path through the trees,
Where the woods keep their secrets with whispering leaves.

When you see beehives, crooked and old,
Leave the main path - that's where lies the gold.

Just a few steps more, past the bees' domain,
Lies a mound of earth I built by hand, plain.

Beneath it, a jar waits, with money inside,
Once hidden within me, now buried to hide.

Dear Resident,

Following the recent act of vandalism that caused the failure of the main water intake, an inspection of nearby water connections was carried out. During the inspection, it was determined that, for reasons unknown, your property is missing its water meter.
To ensure proper billing of water consumption, we have installed a new meter outside your building.

Please remember to pay your water bills on time. Any attempts to remove or tamper with elements of the installation will be treated with due attention.


Kind regards,
Water Network Inspector
Marian Zwis-Koński

P.S. If you happen to come across the brass valve from the main water intake, please discreetly leave it at the office door.

P.P.S. We are pleased to inform you that the issue of E. coli bacteria in the water has been resolved. Let us hope it stays that way this time.

QuestDesc_2: A good power line worker, like a sapper, only makes a mistake once. But after all, who didn't dream as a kid of becoming an electrician? This is your moment - find a way to restore power in the garage.
Stage_2_1: Find the hidden passage at the back of your yard
Stage_2_2: Remove the boards and go through the hole in the fence
Stage_2_3: Find the electrical box on the neighbor's property
Stage_2_4: Flip the switch to turn off the power
Stage_2_5: Steal some electricity by cutting the cables in the right order
QuestDesc_4: Your car, lost in an accident, is rusting away in the yard with no hope for a brighter future. But that might change soon... It'll take some time, but it's time to bring it back to life. For now, let's strip off some rust and give it a fresh coat of paint. Someday, when you gather enough parts, you might just be able to fix it up!
QuestDesc_5: Blonde being blonde, will agree to the fluid exchange in the turn signals, the repair of two gearboxes, or inflating the tires with premium air. For everything, just like with the car, Daddy will pay...
Stage_5_23: Call the customer and tell him the vehicle is ready for pickup
Stage_4_2: Strip the rust off your car
Stage_5_5: Install the "new" battery in the customer's car
Stage_5_10: Place the empty container on the table
Stage_5_12: Pour some petrol into the empty container - 2,5L
Stage_5_14: Pour some water into the container - 2L
Stage_5_15: Pour the mixture into the customer's tank - Fill to 8 liters
Stage_5_17: Place the jack under the customer's car
QuestDesc_6: Here he is - the maharaja of the village in person. Satisfied with his work, he whispers a word to the right people, and customers swarm in. If he's unhappy - you don't want to know.
Stage_4_5: Polish the paint on your car
Stage_2_6: Power's back on - time to return to the garage
Stage_7_4: Take the trash from the garage to the yard gate
Stage_6_22: Finish all necessary tasks, then call the customer
QuestDesc_1: "Every beginning is difficult, but it gets easier from there on." - Erki Nool
Stage_1_1: Go to the impatient customer and take your first job
Stage_1_3: Turn on the light in the garage
Stage_1_5: Scrape the rust off the car body
Stage_1_8: Paint over the remaining rust and the bare metal of the customer's car
Stage_2_7: Turn on the light in the garage
Stage_5_19: Unscrew the rear wheel and remove it from the car
Stage_5_20: Find a new tire to install on the client's car
Stage_5_21: Attach and screw in the wheel to the car
Stage_5_22: Replace the other rear tire in the same way
Stage_6_5: Fill the dents on the customer's car
Stage_6_7: Smooth the putty on the car using the putty polisher
Stage_6_11: Install the "new" fuel filter in the customer's car

Speech_SQMonkasCows-CowsDelivered_07_Mon: I have a better idea! You need to build a fence for them here, the sturdier the better.
Speech_SQMonkasCows-CowsDelivered_08_Pla: Well, okay, let's see what I can do.
Speech_SQMonkasCows-MonologueFence_01_Pl: Damn, she's going to make me build a barn here any minute now... Where am I going to get the fence from? It can't be cheap... But maybe if I look around the village...
Speech_SQMonkasCows-AfterFenceBuilded_01: Okay, the fence is mounted! Monka - now your cows are freely grazing.
Speech_SQMonkasCows-AfterFenceBuilded_02: You know, I found out who unchained my cows...
Speech_SQMonkasCows-AfterFenceBuilded_03: Uh... Monka, don't do anything rash... I can explain it was a...
Speech_SQMonkasCows-AfterFenceBuilded_04: ANDREW, your hell spawn neighbor, damnit.
Speech_SQMonkasCows-AfterFenceBuilded_05: I have seen him loitering around my field, probably to destroy the evidence...
Speech_SQMonkasCows-AfterFenceBuilded_06: Monka... I'll tell you something. Honestly, only between us... You know, you're right. This prick can't be trusted at all, total scumbag!
Speech_SQMonkasCows-AfterFenceBuilded_07: If I were you, I'd send your grandson police officer after him right away, that'll teach this asshat a lesson!
Speech_SQMonkasCows-AfterFenceBuilded_08: Already called! You've got to be quick with people like that! Well - here, take this as a little something for your trouble!
Speech_SQMonkasCows-AfterFenceBuilded_09: Oh, no need - keep the money for medicine or whatever...
Speech_SQMonkasCows-AfterFenceBuilded_10: I'll tell you what - if you're given something, take it; if they hit you, run away!
Speech_SQMonkasCows-AfterFenceBuilded_11: Oh, so it's like that... Well then, thanks!
Speech_SQCliff-NoCarMonologue_01_Player: Hmm - it looks like there's no way through. Maybe I'll come back here once I fix my Fiax, then with a running start I'll smash through that fence!
Speech_SQStyrta-StartMonologue_01_Player: What's that ringing? Must be the phone at the police station?
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkPhone_03_JaninaStyrt: Speakin', Hebel Janice. Bumfuck Nowhere, right here, just past the church...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkPhone_04_JaninaStyrt: HERE. I'M REPORTIN'. AN EXPLOSION. The pile, someone set our pile on fire.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkPhone_08_JaninaStyrt: I already told ye, I don't know who, somebody set it ablaze.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkPhone_12_JaninaStyrt: The pile is burnin', and the pile's nigh burnt clean down already.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkPhone_14_JaninaStyrt: Bumfuck Nowhere, right behind the church round yonder.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkPhone_15_Player: Jesus fucking Christ... And is the fire brigade on the scene?
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkPhone_20_Player: LADY! IS THE FIRE BRIGADE THERE OR NOT?!
Speech_SQStyrta-AfterPhone_01_Player: Fuck, that was a productive conversation... Shame I didn't record it, would've been comedy gold...
Speech_SQStyrta-AfterPhone_02_Player: But I gotta admit, she kinda piqued my interest. Might have to check out that pile up close!
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWC1_02_Player: Uh... I'm sorry? Is everything alright? Asking, cause there are phones ringing here...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWC1_03_Policeman: Hold your horses. It's not like anything's on fire...
Speech_SQStyrta-FireSightMonologue_01_Pl: Oh, something's burning! And of course no firefighters in sight... Where could this old lady even have a water hose?
Speech_SQStyrta-NoWaterSightMonologue_01: Typical - there's no water... And Janice was not lying - the pile of hay's almost gone.
Speech_SQStyrta-NoValveSightMonologue_01: Gotta screw in some valve. But where would I get one?
Speech_SQStyrta-NoValveSightMonologue_02: Hang on... if anything sufficiently round enough can be a steering wheel... then it can definitely be a valve!
Speech_SQStyrta-FirePutDown_01_Player: Phew, the pile's extinguished! Good thing the roof didn't catch fire.
Speech_SQStyrta-FirePutDownRoof_01_Playe: Alright, crisis averted. I'll check if everyone home is safe.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWoman_02_JaninaStyrt: I'm here, I'm here! Thank the Lord ye showed up, boy. I tried callin' the police station, but to no avail!
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWoman_03_JaninaStyrt: Like they weren't even listenin' to me...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWoman_05_JaninaStyrt: Verily I did! I reckoned there weren't a moment to lose!
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWoman_06_Player: Uh... Well, doesn't matter - that phone at the station must be cursed.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWoman_07_Player: I barely heard anything myself once when I called them about... this one particular matter... Aaaanyway... do we even know where the fire came from?
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWoman_08_JaninaStyrt: I suspect there was a third party at play.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWoman_09_JaninaStyrt: Alas, it weren’t granted me to catch the culprit, so to speak, in flagranti, for at that very moment I was peerin’ out the other window, toward the neighbor’s plot.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWoman_10_JaninaStyrt: But somebody was surely lurkin' about - over yonder, behid the haypile. Though he most likely fled into the fields afore ye arrived.
Speech_SQStyrta-TrailFoundMonologue_01_P: Aha! This must've been left by the arsonist! Detective John is on the trail...
Speech_SQStyrta-TrailFollowedMonologue_0: What's this white thing lying here? Some bucket or a helmet?
Speech_SQStyrta-TrailFollowedFurtherMono: He got flung over here... He sure wasn't sober... And he lost something again.
Speech_SQStyrta-TrailFollowedEvenFurther: Tracks lead further into the field...
Speech_SQStyrta-FirefighterFoundMonologu: The trail curves toward the hunting stand...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter0_01_Play: And what are you doing sitting here, mister?
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter0_03_Fire: And by the time you get there, the fire's already over... And that's how it goes...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter0_04_Play: Uhuh, only in this case there actually was a fire.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter0_06_Play: I'm dead serious. But relax - you could've easily missed it, the smoke column was only visible from like 30 kilometers away...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter0_07_Fire: I didn't  see nothin'. I was just sittin' here, downed a beer, stared up at the fi-... the sky... Speakin' of which: got any beer to spare?
Speech_SQStyrta-AfterFirefighterMonologu: I’ll risk the hypothesis that this guy’s speaking straight BS... Maybe alcohol will loosen his tongue.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter1_01_Fire: Ooh, fancy! I'll just set it here, let it settle a bit... Fire, you say? Eh, and I missed it...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter1_02_Play: Funny you should say that, because I found firefighting gear right at the scene. Te tracks led me straight here...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter1_03_Fire: Ah, THAT fire! I remember now - I tried to put it out, but it was too hot and I had to fall back. You can't beat the elements...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter1_04_Fire: Someone must've set it on fire, only who? Hah, we'll probably never know...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter1_05_Fire: ...though one could always speculate over a nice wine. Or just regular wine.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter2_01_Fire: Oh - thank you! What were we talkin' about? Ah right, the haypile fire... Look at that, normally nothin' ever happens in this bumfuck, and then suddenly an opportunity like this slips by...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter2_02_Play: You were about to tell me who set it on fire...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter2_03_Fire: I remember somethin'... But I think I'm soberin' up, 'cause everything's gettin' foggy...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter2_04_Fire: You wouldn't happen to have anything stronger?
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter3_01_Fire: Damn that burns! Now that's fire...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter3_02_Play: Alright alright - what about the arsonist?
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter3_03_Fire: Hmm, this might surprise you... But it was me!
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter3_05_Fire: Well how long can a fella sit around in that firehouse?! Out of boredom a man lights somethin' up now and then, then you go on a call, sirens wailin', water sprayin'!
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter3_06_Fire: But once I'd set it, I remembered that today I'm the only one on duty at the volunteer fire brigade...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter3_07_Fire: Damn, I'm parched - got anything stronger left?
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter3_08_Play: No - enough of this... you drank me dry and caused the woman losses on top of it... I'm goin' to explain to her what the fuck wen down here...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWomanEnd_01_Player: I'm back... Doesn't the lady feel like getting some fresh air? Nothing is burning anymore...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWomanEnd_02_JaninaSt: Eh, no, ever since my door slammed shut on me three years ago, I don't leave the house no more. Sometimes I just crack at the window a wee bit.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWomanEnd_03_Player: Three years, huh? You know, ma'am, I could fix that...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWomanEnd_04_JaninaSt: Thank ye, boy, but there's no need! I lack for nothin', my son brings me food, and I just peek from behind the curtain and keep an eye on everything.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWomanEnd_06_Player: Turns out some pyromaniac fireman set it ablaze. Out of boredom. He's sitting there, drunk, up on the hunting stand.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWomanEnd_07_JaninaSt: Oh, over my dead body! I'm callin' the police!
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWomanEnd_08_JaninaSt: And ye - here, take this key.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWomanEnd_09_JaninaSt: In the shed, there's a wardrobe with my late husband's old odds and ends - take whatever ye need, with my gratitude!
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWomanEnd_11_JaninaSt: Don't mention it! Fine you man ye are...
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkWomanEnd_12_JaninaSt: HELLO, POLICE... YES, YES, HEBEL JANICE... WHAT? I DON'T KNOW WHO...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_01_D: Johnny, buddy! Fancy helping out an artist in need?
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_02_P: An artist? And what exactly is it you do?
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_03_D: I aspire to become the best DJ in the neighbourhood - hell, even the world!
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_05_D: Hey, low blow... not cool... So are you gonna help me out or not? I need this piece of junk overhauled.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_06_D: We'll turn it into the best part-mobile in the area! That's the foundation of this profession.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_07_P: To become a DJ you need a better ride? That's not how it works, but fine, I don't judge - what do you need?
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_08_D: First of all, proper speakers. Ones that will make sure everyone hears the music before i arrive at the fire station.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_09_D: Plus neon lights on the sides! THey've gotta glow like a dog's... you know what!
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_10_D: And on the roof I need a light and sirens. Police ones. Then slap on some fancy-coloured paint job...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_11_P: Hold up, hold up - police ones?
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_12_D: Yeah - it's gotta do that cool "wee-woo wee-woo".
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_14_D: Obviously! Keys! Turns out I don't own any, and a DJ without a keyboard is... well, you know.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_15_P: Well, I know that when I start disassembling the police cars, they'll lock me up and throw away the KEY.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_16_P: This is going to cost you a pretty penny, you realise?
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_17_D: Of course, I'll reward you handsomely!
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-InitialTalk_22_P: Sigh... Fine - I'll wait for when you bring your car over. No way I'm messing around with it here...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-JobAccepted_01_P: Alright, here's the plan - first I'll "borrow" the parts from that police car. If they lock me up, at least I won't have to hunt down the rest of this junk...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-CameraSpotted_01: Shit, is that a camera? Gotta deal with it or they'll have me on a plate...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-CameraSpotted_02: Let's pray it's the only one...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-AfterPoliceCar_0: Sweet! Now quickly to the church to nick the speakers for the procession...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-Eavesdrop_02_Org: God bless. Last time I went to confession was...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-Eavesdrop_03_Cle: Alright alright, son, I haven't got all day. Get to the point.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-Eavesdrop_05_Cle: Ooh, straight to the point, huh... Well, I asked for it... So... how often do you commit this sin...?
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-Eavesdrop_06_Org: How often? Father - self-abuse has become practically routine for me... I structure my whole day around it:
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-Eavesdrop_07_Org: Morning wake-up, quick wank, post-lunch rematch, and in the evening a full all hands on board match for honour...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-Eavesdrop_08_Org: And when needed, I also take penalties... An hour without a jerk is an hour wasted!
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-Eavesdrop_09_Org: I used to do it for pleasure, now I do it to stay in shape. Like Andre Agassi!
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-Eavesdrop_10_Org: I think about it non-stop, even at work - though I really shouldn't there...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-Eavesdrop_13_Cle: Wait, Crispin?! Stop wasting my time and get the speakers ready for the procession!
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-Eavesdrop_14_Org: I can't, the village headman took them. For some harvest festival or fair.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-Eavesdrop_15_Cle: What? By what right?? I'll have a word with him myself...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-Eavesdrop_16_Pla: Organist-onanist? That's a new one for me...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-Eavesdrop_17_Pla: But at least I know where the speakers are.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-PoliceCarStarted: There's bound to be more of this gear somewhere around here, I just need to search properly.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-AfterSpeakers_01: So what's next? Ah right, those LEDs for the lighting... but that's probably beyond little Andy's budget. Chistmas lights will make a worthy substitute...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-BeforeOrganist_0: Only the keyboard left. I'll ask our ona... I mean, organist if he's got one.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-OrganistTalk_03_: I need to score a keyboard from somewhere, got one for sale by any chance?
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-OrganistTalk_04_: As it happens I do - served me faithfully, but I got a new one, I can let the old one got a modest fee.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-OrganistTalk_05_: How about this deal - you drop the price and I don't spread it around the village about your... manual hobbies.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-OrganistTalk_06_: What? How did you... Fine, whatever - I'll cut the price in half, but that's my final offer!
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-KeyboardBought_0: Deal, I'll take it! Uhh, why's it so sticky...?
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-BackWithKeyboard: But what am I gonna rest this keyboard on? Right - got it: my mother's ironing board. Should be somewhere in the house.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-JobFinished_01_P: Aaaand I fucking nailed it! Time to visit Stanley - for such a perfectly executed job I deserve some kind of bonus!
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-FinishTalk_01_DJ: Oh - hey John. Beautiful work on that party-mobile!
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-FinishTalk_02_Pl: Yeah - enjoy it while the cops search for the sirens and emergency light...
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-FinishTalk_03_DJ: Relax - it's called occupational hazard - and for sticking your neck out I've got a little reward for you.
Speech_SQDropTheBaseSon-FinishTalk_05_Pl: Oh... Yeah, that was totally... fucking worth it.
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-InitialJanuszMono: A wedding gate? Henry's marrying off his daughter? No way!
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-InitialDialogue_0: Goddamn wind, and no what the hell am I supposed to do...
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_01_P: Hey there Mr. Henry! What's up?
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_02_H: Oh John... it's a fucking tragedy. My daughter got knocked up... Gotta throw a quick wedding together, before her belly pops out and the whole village starts yapping...
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_03_P: Oh! So... congratulations? And who's the lucky bastard?
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_05_P: That redhead? Maciągowa's one? Girl's got taste, I won't lie... Heh, it'll be just like that song on the radio: Ginger's gettin' married!
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_06_H: Ah, give me a break! Of all the sons-in-law I could get... This one tools around in a Gulv 3, aluminum rims, boombox, big shot...
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_07_H: But for a pack of rubbers at 3$ the budget somehow ran dry...
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_08_H: That he's unemployed I could still swallow... I'd throw him some under-the-table work at my shop.
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_09_H: He knocked up my daughter - hell, I wasn't no saint myself - Mariolka was an "oops" as well... But he's a REDHEAD - that I just can't choke down... Ugly as sin and the hair's pure fake, too!
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_10_H: And now I still gotta scrape up a car for 'em so they can roll up to the church "with class"...
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_11_P: Can't they just take his Gulv?
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_12_H: In the same heap that cooked up the kid in her?! To the church? Over my dead body!
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_13_H: Listen here... You got the car canal and the gear, and I got this old beater under the shed.
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_14_H: Can you clean it up and slap some white paint on it? So it don't look like a total embarrasment...
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_15_P: Paint the whole damn body? That won't be cheap, that will take at least two cans...
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_16_H: Fine, we'll work something out... I'll dig into that little tramp's envelope and throw you some extra! Just one more thing...
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_18_H: Cause they wished they could have some balloons on the side mirrors... So I grabbed the company ones from the warehouse, should do the job - I thought.
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_19_H: But today it's blowin' so hard it snatched them all from the yard, only a handful left.
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_20_H: Mind looking for them? Just don't touch the ones on the wedding gate! Spent all day yesterday hanging 'em up there.
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_21_P: Oh, Mr. Henry, this is starting to look like serious business...
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-MainDialogue_22_H: No worries, I'll pay proper. Grabbing the keys and I'll be over in a minute.
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-BalloonJanuszMono: Hmm... Henry mentioned something about balloons on his plot.
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-AllBalloonsMounte: For fucks sake... this is supposed to be a wedding, not a goddamn commercial event... Screw it, fine.
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-FinishDialogue_01: All done, Mr. Henry. Washed, painted, balloons in place. Ready to hitch 'em!
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-FinishDialogue_02: Now it looks decent! With those balloons it's downright festive. Touched it up a bit after you too.
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-FinishDialogue_03: So... uh... where do we stand with that envelope?
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-FinishDialogue_04: RIght... here, take it. Pinched it from the bride - thanks to her little adventures with Rick I only got gray hairs out of the deal.
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-FinishDialogue_05: I recommend myself for the future!
Speech_SQLifeFindsAWay-FinishDialogue_06: Hope I won't need it. I don't have any more daughters. I think.
Speech_SQStyrta-TalkFirefighter0_02_Fire: Ah , 'cause a fireman's life is hard... When you're in the mood to put out fires, there aren't any. When there IS a fire, you don't feel like goin'...
