ToolDesc_WoDe70: If something doesn't move but it should, that means you need to use WoDe-69.
ToolDesc_Shovel: For digging, re-digging, un-digging, and generally shovel-ing your way through life. Perfect for all your sand, dirt, and mystery hole needs!
ToolDesc_PolishingDisc: It is a replaceable attachment for an angle grinder. It can be used to polish freshly applied paint.
ToolDesc_GrindingDisc: This is a replaceable attachment for an angle grinder. It's perfect for removing rust, paint, dirt - and possibly even your deepest regrets.
ToolDesc_WireBrush: It's suitable for rust removal, although it wears out fairly quickly and the work with it is quite tedious.
ToolDesc_RatchetWrench: It's suitable for tightening and loosening screws - but it does it faster than a standard wrench.
ToolDesc_FillingSpatula_Small: Spatula for applying putty to dents. It's small, so it applies less filler. This makes it slower, but also more precise.
ToolDesc_CarLift: A larger version of the car jack. It allows for faster lifting of the vehicle.
ToolDesc_FillContainer: With the help of a putty knife, you can apply filler to the dents, and in doing so, you can sell the car with the description "never been in an accident".
ToolDesc_PotatoesContainer: A container, which is a great tool for holding or collecting potatoes.
ToolDesc_FullPotatoesContainer: A container, which is full of potatoes.
Tut_Walking:
Use the 'W,S,A,D' keys to move around.
Use the 'Shift' key to run.
Tut_CarJack:
To remove the wheels you must first jack up the vehicle to the maximum height.
Hold 'LMB' on the jack.
Tut_Fluids:
You can refill or change the fluids in every car.
Just remove the cap from the specific tank and add the required fluid. Remember to put the cap back on after you're done!
Tut_InteractionTools:
Press 'E' to pick up tools
If you want to throw them away, use 'G'
Tut_UsingGrinder: Time to scrape off some rust! Use 'LMB' on the car body.
Tut_FuseBox:
Begin stealing power from the electrical box by clicking on the cables in the correct order with the 'E' key.
You have to do this before the power comes back, otherwise it might give you a little shock.
Tut_ScrewDrainPlug: Remember to put the drain plug back on before you start adding the new oil! Otherwise everything will spill out.
Tut_Grabbing: Use 'LMB' to pick up an object
Tut_QuestAndTasks:
On the left side of the screen you will see the current story mission.
On the right - information about the current job.
Tut_Mess: In the top right corner you can see the level of sloppy work done in the current job.
Tut_YellowMarks: Job criteria with a yellow checkmark mean that the task has been completed, but sloppily. They indicate that the car is ready for turn in, but the client may not want to accept it. You might save some cash, but you're taking a risk!
Tut_RedMarks:
If some job criteria have a red cross next to them, the job is not suitable for turn in.
A job can be turned in only and exclusively if all tasks are completed at least with a yellow checkmark.
Tut_MessMenu: Press 'Tab' to see detailed information about the job criteria and sloppiness levels.
Tut_SpraySize:
The spray paint gets used up during painting, so stay mindful of that.
You can use 'scroll' to change the size of the painted area.
Tut_PaintInsteadGrinding:
Instead of of scraping off the rust, you might as well paint over it. However, that's going to affect the level of sloppiness!
Remember, you can press 'G' to throw the tool you're holding.
Tut_Polishing:
Enough, no one will check this with a gauge...
Change the disc in the angle grinder to a polishing one so the paint looks like the original.
Tut_RepairOwnCar:
Now it's time to fix your ride. Remove the rust and spray paint it however you want. 
Just remember - don’t cut corners on your own turf!
Tut_BorrowElectricity:
Looks like the power is out - did someone forget to pay the bills? 
Maybe you'll borrow some electricity from the neighbor? He surely won't get offended.
Tut_RemovePart:
Some parts are attached with screws.
You need to remove them before you remove the part!
Tut_MixFluids:
You can save some cash by mixing fluids together, for example petrol with water.
Remember - if you overdo the proportions, it will affect the level of sloppiness. The car won't run on water alone.
Tut_MixStation: You can only mix fluids on the professional fluid mixing table. Place the canister on the table by pressing 'E'.
Tut_Wrench: To take off the wheel you need to use a wrench to remove all the screws.
Tut_Sign_Paint: And now go get some spray and paint your new sign!
Tut_Tires:
Angelica's tire could still be used for a bit, for example in your car! 
When you finish tinkering with it, accept the next job.
Tut_PartAccess:
To get to a part, sometimes you need to disassemble other ones. 
Click on the part. if something is blocking it, it will light up yellow. Some elements require unscrewing with a wrench.
Tut_PartInstalled: If a part has any mountings such as screws, remember that only tightening all of them will allow you to mount the next part to it.
Tut_DrainFluid:
If the car requires changing the fluid, you must first completely empty the tank.
The drain plug is easier to reach from the service pit.
Tut_PuttySmooth:
Fresh filler needs to be smoothed - try it out. 
If you just spray paint over it, it will affect the level of sloppiness - and we don't want to annoy Christopher even more.
Tut_Cleaning: Time for some spring cleaning - carry out the unnecessary boxes from the garage to the gate so that the garbage truck takes them.
Tut_CallCustomer: Okay, that will do. Call Seba to let him know he can pick up his old heap!
Tut_Pliers:
Some parts are held by clips or clamps. 
You can disassemble them with pliers.
Tut_InstallPart: To mount a part, aim at the proper place in the car and then release it.
Tut_ChangeTire:
Click on the part, and all the screws that hold it will light up!
Aim at the screw with the wrench and use  LMB for tightening, and RMB for unscrewing
Tut_Dropping: Press 'G' to throw away held objects
Tut_CompleteAllTasks:
To complete the job, its subpoints must be marked as minimum yellow.
Press 'Tab' to check the details of the job and the sloppy work done.
Tut_Lever: Flip the lever to cut off the power
Tut_InstalWheel:
Great! look for a tire to replace the old one. put it on the rim and mount the wheel. 
Remember - unscrewed parts affect sloppiness!
Tut_FindBattery: Look around your garage for a new battery. There was one you didn't need laying somewhere around here.
Tut_FindAlternator:
Well yes, the old alternator is removed, but where to get a new one...?
Maybe the neighbor's got something lying around...
Tut_WaterHose:
Christopher Kingman's car is dirtier than his conscience...
Take the hose and wash it.
Tut_Putty: Christopher apparently banged up his car a bit. Time to get rid of the dents. Take the putty knife!
Tut_NoCustomers:
Not many clients recently, huh? Has the word gotten out that you do sloppy work...? 
Time to change that, advertisement is the key to business' success!
Tut_Sign_Name:
Now for the hardest part: come up with a name for your mechanic shop. It must be short and catchy!
PS: "John's Auto Repair" is not very original.
Tut_GoodMarketing:
Your marketing works faster than you think...
Talk to the next client and see how to rip him... serve him!
Tut_Boombox: What kind of mechanic shop is this without music blasting at full volume? Turn on the boombox!
Tut_Sign: To assemble the sign, grab its parts with 'LPM' and put them in the marked places.
Tut_Lean: Press 'Z' to lean in for a better view under the hood.
Tut_FindFuelFilter:
Some fuel filter was lying on the cabinet in the living room recently...
That should do.
Tut_MixingDishSoap: Mix budget fluids to replace the original, but remember - not all are suitable. Control the Sloppiness indicator!
Tut_NpcTasks: Talk to the neighbors to discover new side quests.
Tut_FellingSite:
On the logging site you can find logs of wood.
Look in from time to time and completely legally borrow a few...
Tut_Alcohol:
Alright, time for a beer!
Work somehow always goes smoother with a little buzz.
Tut_DrinkingAlcohol:
Drink by holding 'LMB'.
Turn in the job while 'buzzed', and you'll get an extra bonus!
Tut_RunningOutDiscs:
Grinder discs wear out during work.
Install a new disc.
Tut_Decorations:
Decorations decrease your sloppiness points.
The car may not want to start, but at least it's pretty? Surely the client will be satisfied.
Tut_WoDe_Using: Hold 'LMB' on a rusty screw or clip to loosen it.
Tut_GenericJobs:
From now on, clients will regularly come to your driveway.
Serve them to earn cash or go deal with other matters - the client will wait!
Tut_BikeEQ:
You can hide tools, car parts and other objects in the bicycle trunk.
Take the wrench into your hand and click 'E' on the trunk!
Tut_CarEQ:
On the roof of your car you can stuff much more than into the trunk of a bicycle!
You can pick up an object and put it on the roof to strap it on.
Tut_RequiredParts:
But the intake pipe you removed is essential for the car to work and you can't hand over the job without it - reinstall it.
Details under 'Tab'.
Tut_DrainFluidWithHose:
Some tanks, like the ones holding oil or coolant, can be emptied by taking off the drain plug on the bottom of the car.
Other fluids, such as fuel, should be siphoned out through the filler neck using a special hose.
Tut_RepairOwnCar_2:
Repairing your own vehicle consists of several stages.
Look into the Journal ('Tab') to see what is missing and get the necessary parts.
Tut_FillingContainer: Take some filler from the bucket and apply a thin, 2-centimeter layer...
Tut_Catalog: You can buy new parts using the catalog.
Tutorial_NewGarageCatalog: From now on you have access to the entire catalog from "SCRAP" in your own garage. Only 10% more expensive...
Tut_StolenAirFilter:
Brand new filter! What if we... swiped it? 
Come on, Angelica won't notice!
Tut_CarTrunk: The liftgate of a Mini Fiax can be taken off to make the access to the engine easier.
Tut_Zoom: You can zoom in with the 'C' key.
Tut_DoorLockLatch: The neighbor apparently had a nice lock on the shed...
Tut_Tights:
The stockings have been recently laying somewhere in the house...
You could also buy them or find another pair somewhere else!
WorkshopUpgrade_Desc_Rack: A large shelf unit for storing various items.
WorkshopUpgrade_Desc_FluidMixingStation: A special "alchemical" station that lets you mix different substances. Sure, you could just pour water and gasoline straight into the customer's tank. But if you'd rather prepare your own blends outside the vehicle - say, in an empty canister - then this is something for you.
WorkshopUpgrade_Desc_Workbench: A large workbench that makes handling various parts easier. You can place parts, tools - or whatever else you need - right on it.
WorkshopUpgrade_Desc_Shelf: A small shelf for storing various items.
WorkshopUpgrade_Desc_WaterHose: A rubber garden hose for spraying water. Handy when you need to wash a car.
Workshop_BrokenProp_Workbench:
Destroyed workbench
A new one can be purchased at the hardware store
Workshop_BrokenProp_FluidMixingStation:
Broken fluid mixing station
A new one can be purchased at the hardware store
Workshop_BrokenProp_SmallShelf:
Broken shelf
A new one can be purchased at the hardware store
Workshop_BrokenProp_Rack:
Broken rack
A new one can be purchased at the hardware store
Workshop_BuyUpgradeInStore: To repair it, go to the hardware store
WorkshopUpgrade_StorageChest_Desc: Makes it easier to store the most important and valuable items. After purchase, it can be found in the garage, under the desk.
WorkshopUpgrade_ToolBoard_Desc: A special organizer designed to keep your most essential tools in one place. Buy it and you’ll never lose your wrench again!
